# Abdelrahman Aly

> Software Development Engineer II at Amazon Web Services (AWS), based in Gdańsk, Poland. Also known as Abdo.

## About

Abdelrahman Aly is a Software Engineer with 6 years of experience specializing in backend systems, cloud architecture, and distributed systems. He currently works on the AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) team, focused on database modernization and enabling enterprises to migrate legacy workloads to modern AWS native architectures.

## Current Role

- **Company**: Amazon Web Services (AWS)
- **Title**: Software Development Engineer II — RDS/DMS
- **Focus**: Database migrations, cloud-native architectures, distributed systems
- **Location**: Gdańsk, Poland
